title: Choose the Service Binder composition
question: The visual world and typography are fixed. Choose the dashboard structure that should carry into the app.

options.label: Work Sheet
options.lineage: the approved sketch, resolved as production UI
options.thesis: A main chart anchors one continuous inspection sheet with readings around its edges.
options.viewport: CPU and memory lead into one large live chart, a condition register, and a lower hardware strip.
options.risk: The dashboard needs a careful compact layout because the chart owns most of the width.

options.label: Inspection Ledger
options.lineage: service readings arranged as inspection rows
options.thesis: Every core metric receives a row with current, trend, range, and plain status.
options.viewport: Four broad metric rows sit beside a shared chart and watch log.
options.risk: The rigid row rhythm gives the overview less visual contrast.

options.label: Two-Page Folio
options.lineage: an open service manual with a central seam
options.thesis: A concise inspection summary faces a full live-history page.
options.viewport: Condition and readings occupy the left page; history and events occupy the right.
options.risk: The book-like split becomes tight in compact windows.
